We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets. The Team Production Engineering is responsible for the daily operation of Clear Street's trading systems — a set of distributed network applications running on Linux hosts, integrated with liquidity venues, clearing houses, and exchanges that support billions in trading volume per day. We use a mix of open-source and proprietary software to provide low-latency direct market access across asset classes. The team's work centers on three areas: monitoring and alerting (Grafana, Wireshark), deployment and testing (Ansible, pytest), and system optimization (C++, hardware testing). The Role Own the daily operation of production trading systems: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and troubleshooting across Linux hosts and network infrastructure. Build and extend our monitoring and alerting stack (Grafana, Wireshark) and our deployment and testing tooling (Ansible, pytest), treating infrastructure as code and servers as cattle, not pets. Optimize system performance at the software and hardware level — latency, throughput, and jitter — including work in C++ and hands-on hardware testing. Interface with the many external venue and counterparty systems our platform connects to; notice failure patterns and propose upgrades that make the whole system more resilient. Weigh risk and reward in real time on decisions that affect live trading, and help traders and other non-technical users navigate those choices. What We Value Technical curiosity: a relentless drive to understand how things work under the hood — not satisfied with "it works," you want to know why. Attention to detail: in trading, accuracy is paramount; you take pride in reliable code and graceful handling of edge cases. Tactical judgment: the ability to make thoughtful risk/reward trade-offs, with incomplete information, on decisions that impact the bottom line of a live trading business. High ownership and accountability, strong collaboration across engineering, trading, and operations, and satisfaction in work with a direct, measurable impact. Requirements 1–3 years of professional experience in production engineering, site reliability engineering, systems administration, or a related field. Linux native: comfortable with file and process management, system troubleshooting, debugging, configuration, and networking. Strong command of Python for backend development — clean, efficient, Pythonic code. A GitOps mindset: you understand the value of treating infrastructure as code. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Nice To Haves Familiarity with C++ — our high-performance trading engines run on it, and the ability to read and interface with that codebase is valuable. This role is based in our New York office four days per week; in-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views. Our top priority is our people. We're continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality.

You will architect the platforms that design, deploy, validate and operate our networks at global scale, lead the hardest engineering problems hands-on, and grow the network software capability of the team. Design and build core services yourself, writing and reviewing production code in Python or Go. Lead the design of network telemetry, observability and analytics at scale, and use them to automate operations. Lead the use of AI and machine learning in network operations, such as anomaly detection, troubleshooting assistants and automated change review. Partner with network architecture, security and engineering leaders to make the network software-defined from design through operation. Responsible for the safety of automated production changes, and lead incident reviews where software is involved. Mentor senior engineers and grow the network software engineering capability of the team. Growth Opportunities Define how a network built for AI at global scale is run as software. Influence architecture, tooling and team structure as Network Engineering grows. review_candidates.description: Job Overview Job Title: NC3 Telecommunication Specialist (TESA) Location : Ramstein AB, Germany Job Responsibilities The NC3 Telecommunication Specialist (TESA) shall provide day-to-day operation and maintenance support for various strategic SATCOM equipment fielded. This include on the spot training. The position also can include be the SATCOM Planner for strategic systems. Collaborate with the Senior Engineers to create more efficient methods. Protocol/Network Theory Experience. Understanding, configuration and troubleshooting ability of DMVPN Architecture. Perform routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, RIP and RIP). Knowledge of switching fundamentals (Virtual Local Area Network System (VLANS), VLAN Trunk Protocol (VTP), Port Security, Spanning Tree). Familiarity with Cisco Encryption Concepts within a DMVPN Architecture. Understanding of Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) Acceleration over Satellite concepts. Plan, install, operate, and maintain Promina-based TCF systems for the communications network. Analyze equipment capabilities, limitations, troubleshooting methods, and security protocols to support full TCF operations and link restoration. Perform advanced corrective maintenance at the chassis-mounted component level within Technical Control Facilities. Evaluate and re-engineer complex circuits and link restoration strategies to support critical communications infrastructure. Document technical data during installation and troubleshooting using logs, trouble tickets, outage reports, or Equipment Repair Orders (ERO). Coordinate activation, deactivation, and fault isolation of communication circuits across multiple services, agencies, time zones, and nationalities. Minimum Qualifications An Active, in-scope US Government issued Secret clearance (Interim Secret Clearance is acceptable). Due to the nature of the work and contract requirements, US Citizenship is required. Candidate must meet the applicable DoD 8140 qualification requirements for the assigned work role. DoD 8140 Work Role(s): 441 - Network Operations Specialist, (Intermediate); and may qualify through education, military training, certifications, or a combination thereof. Qualifying 8140 credentials include a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering or completion of relevant military communications or network training. Qualifying 8140 certifications may include Security+, Cloud+, GCIH, SSCP, GSEC, SecurityX/CASP+, CCNA or other DoD 8140-approved certifications. Higher proficiency-level or equivalent DoD 8140-approved certifications applicable to the assigned work role may also be accepted. At least two (2) years of experience in support of installations, repair, troubleshooting or maintenance of communications electronic systems or equipment. At least two (2) years of experience operating in a tactical environment operating/maintaining antenna controllers, SSPA, LNA/LNB, up and down converters, Fiber optic/Coax/Ethernet Cable, Frequency Division Multiple Access (FDMA) and Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) modems (satellite modems). Experience and skill with commercial and military satellite acquisition procedures and commercial TDMA/DAMA modems required. Able to travel to support mission up to 50%. Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, OR an Associate’s degree plus seven (7) years of recent specialized experience, OR a certification plus 7 years of recent specialized experience, OR eleven (11) years of recent specialized experience. We provide enterprise IT, engineering, full life-cycle communications, cybersecurity, cloud and virtualization services and solutions to the United States Department of Defense and other federal agencies. To Apply: We invite you to put your talents to work by joining a growing team of dynamic professionals here at Trace Systems! Be part of a culture at our leading-edge company where you can achieve great things while fostering a satisfying and rewarding career progression. To learn more about our current openings, text ‘tracejobs’ to 97211 or apply directly through our website at: www.tracesystems.com. #jointracesystems Trace Systems is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates will be considered without regard to legally protected characteristics.
